# Native API headers

These five headers are copied without modification from the user-provided
`1cits_exe_doc_10_2_DOC_10_2 (2).zip`, nested archive
`DOC_10_2/1CGetImageFragment.zip`, directory
`1CGetImageFragment/trunk/include`.

They describe the 1C Native API used by the supplied example. No prebuilt DLL,
GDI+ image-fragment code or old Visual Studio project has been copied.
The archive supplies no separate license file; rights to these SDK headers
remain with their respective owners. Check distribution terms before publication.
